_comment: Byte-exact vectors for benchproto's frame envelope (benchproto_frame.c/.h). Same convention as CommonFW/test/vectors/frame_vectors.json (kilnlink's own), but for the separate benchproto protocol family -- see firmware/CommonFW/docs/BENCHPROTO.md. Hand-computed by an independent Python implementation of the same spec (poly 0x1021, init 0xFFFF, no reflection, no xorout; SLIP-style 0x7E/0x7D byte stuffing) inlined in firmware/CommonFW/test/test_benchproto_frame.c, not generated from benchproto_frame.c itself, so a bug shared between the two would still show up as a mismatch here. Unlike kilnlink's manifest, this one has no second production implementation to cross-check against yet -- SimFW's PC-side `kilnsim` link layer (a separate, later piece of work per SimFW/docs/DESIGN_NOTES.md sec 6) is expected to become that second implementation and should be checked against this same manifest when it exists.

hostile_vectors._comment: Not concrete byte sequences here (the C test constructs these directly, same as kilnlink's test_frame.c) -- listed for documentation/future PC-side parity: truncated frame, LENGTH byte exceeding BENCHPROTO_FRAME_MAX_PAYLOAD, LENGTH/buffer-size mismatch, corrupted CRC byte, unrecognized type byte, unterminated trailing 0x7D escape, output buffer too small for stuff()/encode_raw().
